title: AgentsData
description:
`topos agents` — the pick where you stand and what is installed on this machine.
**INFERRED** (additive-only).

agents.description: The picked agents' registry slugs, as the file spells them (`"*"` = every installed agent).

hooks.description: The auto-update hook state of each picked agent at this scope, probed read-only.

installed.description: Every agent installed on this machine (its detect dir exists), in harness-table order.

not_in_table.description:
The picked slugs this binary's harness table does not know (a row a newer table dropped,
or a hand-edited file). Kept in the pick as written; they pick nothing until a table
knows them again, and `agents remove` takes them out. **Additive.**

pick_path.description: The pick file in force, as a person reads it; absent when no pick stands.

source.description:
Where the pick comes from: `"project"` (the project's own file) or `"machine"` (the
machine file, inherited inside a project). Absent when no pick stands.

warnings.description:
The lines `--gitignore` raised (a `.gitignore` that is a symlink out of the checkout is
not edited, and says so here). **Additive.**

Message.description:
One message: the machine-readable code (when the producer has one), what kind of thing it is,
and the ONE sentence a person reads. `text` never carries the code — a code is a lookup key,
not prose, and the TTY prints `text` alone.

code.description:
The stable SCREAMING_SNAKE code an agent branches on. Absent where the producer has no
code (a decision, a paging fact) — an open vocabulary, exactly like `WireError.code`.

text.description: The line a person reads. Complete on its own; no code, no Rust type name.

MessageKind.description:
What a [`Message`] IS, so a consumer never has to infer it from wording. `failure` is the only
kind that says something did not happen; `decision` is a bundle waiting on a person; `advisory`
annotates something that still worked; `disclosure` states a fact about work that succeeded.

StatusTrigger.description:
One picked agent's auto-update trigger presence in a [`StatusData`] — a read-only probe of
the same artifact the arming sweep manages. **INFERRED** (additive-only).

armed.description:
Provable presence of the topos trigger ARTIFACT right now — a footprint read, which is
why every surface built on it says "registered" rather than "armed": the artifact stands,
and nothing here watched it fire. Absent = unknowable without a live probe `status`
refuses to run (a scheduler that must be dialed to answer).

last_run_age_ms.description:
How long ago this agent's hook last RAN a sweep on this machine (milliseconds), when one
has ever been observed — the evidence that turns "registered" into "seen working". Only
hooks that name their caller can leave it (`--hook`/`--from`), so absence never proves a
trigger dead. **INFERRED** (additive-only).

note.description: A short honesty note (e.g. why `armed` is unknown), when one is needed.
